blurb: Black Gold Golf Club features a par-72 layout playing up to 6,756 yards, designed by Arthur Hills. The course includes water features, elevation changes, rolling hills, strategic bunkering, and views of coastal Orange & Los Angeles Counties. The venue also offers banquet facilities, a wedding ceremony lawn, and a restaurant for events.
